# Markdown to HTML

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/markdown-to-html/

Convert Markdown into sanitized HTML with a visible preview. Copy the markup or download a small standalone HTML document.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Draft a heading, a bullet list and a link in Markdown, then export the formatted document.

## Limits and checks

Scripts, styles, embedded images and form controls are removed from the preview. Review any external links you include.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
